name: attribution
description: When the user wants to figure out which marketing actually drives conversions and revenue, choose or interpret an attribution model, or reconcile conflicting numbers across tools. summary_zh: 一套营销归因分析工具，帮助判断真正带来转化和收入的渠道，并解决不同平台数据冲突问题。
